#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/.venv/bin/activate
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Running profiling case: toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Higher-resolution (32^3 grid, 32768 dofs, degree-3 splines) periodic-slab ToyDrift setup, solving the per-step guiding-center Poisson problem with either feectools' native preconditioned CG (--solver pcg) or PETScSolver with an algebraic multigrid preconditioner (KSP=cg, PC=gamg, --solver petsc). At this size pcg needs roughly 190 iterations per solve (about 11 seconds) while PETSc+gamg needs about 2 (a third of a second); the ratio (~38x) is similar to the smaller periodic_slab case, but the absolute per-solve cost -- and hence the real wall-clock impact over a full run -- is far larger here."
echo "Physics problem: Electrostatic E x B drift of a single ion species in a periodic slab."
echo "Struphy model used: ToyDrift"
echo "Case directory: /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T203630Z-cb69555b/toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc"
echo "----------------------------------------"
mkdir -p "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T203630Z-cb69555b/toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc/sim_02"
cp "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/profiling/examples/ToyDrift/periodic_slab_hires/params_periodic_slab_hires.py" "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T203630Z-cb69555b/toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc/parameters.py"

echo "Running toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc with 1 MPI ranks"
cd "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T203630Z-cb69555b/toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc"
mpirun -n 1 /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/.venv/bin/python /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/profiling/examples/ToyDrift/periodic_slab_hires/params_periodic_slab_hires.py --id 2 --solver petsc > "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T203630Z-cb69555b/toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc/sim_02/struphy.out" 2>&1

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Completed profiling case: toydrift_periodic_slab_hires_petsc (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "----------------------------------------"
